named_external_and_bind_preservation.method: Named attached sentinel survives both scope deletions with raw inspect exit0, then is separately deleted by probe owner. Bind after-delete evidence is boolean-only: advisory raw-evidence gap, not observed source behavior defect.

bounded_cleanup.method: At most logs once and rm twice, each timeout cleanup_seconds 1..300, TERM then kill-after1s; child-group termination polls 20x0.05s then KILL. Separate operation budgets, not one global cleanup deadline. Temp child escalation observed exit137 within2.01s. No live Docker stall rerun; uninterruptible OS/daemon work and filesystem failure not universal wall-clock guarantees.

43_test_regression_signal_timeout_transp.method: Existing raw log 43 passed; 42 observation files correspond to 43 tests minus two static checks plus one extra concurrent invocation. 41 canonical invocations and one historical known-bad, exact created/removed ID sets validated. Logs/observations retain timeout124, signal130/143/129, wait transport42, wait-signal143/137, invalid status65, diagnostics failure and workload beyond startup deadline. findings.title: Bind preservation lacks raw host-source postcheck
evidence: runner-volume-scope-preservation.json: bindSourceRetained=true; commands record mount and container deletion but no host stat/read/hash after removal
findings.impact: The operation boundary and canonical source support preservation, but the bind boolean cannot independently prove source content continuity.
findings.recommendation: In future evidence capture a synthetic bind sentinel hash/stat before and after owned container removal, before probe teardown. Do not reopen implementation solely for this reporting gap.

findings.title: Raw test logs omit outer process exit receipts
evidence: runner-volume-tests-red.log: 2 failed,41 skipped; runner-volume-tests-green.log:43 passed; neither prints outer exit status
findings.impact: Exact outer npm/Vitest process exits are not directly recoverable from these two logs. Regression result and fixture runner exits are observable.
findings.recommendation: Future test command records should retain exact outer argv and numeric process exit with raw log hash; do not fabricate 1/0 receipts retrospectively.

limitations: Real 0/37 runs changed only the create final workload argv through the recorded Python executable; certify:phase11 was not executed and this is not certification.
Named/bind scope probes reproduce the same removal operation on never-started containers, not canonical workload execution.
Unattached foreign volume preservation in runner-volume-real-green.json is boolean-only; attached external named volume has raw inspect proof in new scope artifact.
Final-binding JSON was inventoried/hash-read but its absent-container assertions and 43PASS claim were not used as independent behavioral proof.

Historical wrapper/workflow source files, prior critic reports, vendor/cache and private backups were not opened; historical and workflow assertions are limited to admitted canonical test and raw fixture evidence.
No current Docker state, source content outside admitted scope, or broader project regression revalidated.
Automatic deletion cannot guarantee remote resource absence after daemon/API failure or missing creation acknowledgement; runner logs cleanup failure and preserves original result.
